en.hubeali: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup>, and Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> were wearing rings in their<sup>asws</sup> left hands’.
en.sarwar: 12. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith
the following is narrated: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that Ali, al-Hassan and al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, would wear the ring on their left hands.’”
